## USB Drive Inventory Collector 4.3.1

- The status panel now fades to soft green when a drive is saved and soft red when scanning is paused manually. Error messages continue to use the red status background.
- Opening the embedded Terminal now takes over after a routine disk check, without reporting that a drive is being read. If an identity read is in progress, it waits for the result to be saved before switching to Terminal.
- Saved-drive, duplicate, and error statuses remain visible for at least four seconds before the waiting message returns.
